name: Pittaya UI
summary: Open-source React component library built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui and Radix UI.
description: A production-oriented React component library on Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind CSS 4 and Radix UI. Shipped components: Button, Card, Carousel, Tabs, Announcement Badge, Copy Button, Orbit Images and an Installation Section, with more on a public roadmap. The docs system offers live previews, copy-paste snippets, API reference and accessibility notes.
